title: SugarCraft — CandyInput
description: CandyInput: Terminal escape sequence decoder — keys, Kitty keyboard protocol, SGR 1006 mouse, focus, bracketed paste. The input layer PHP TUIs have been missing.
ogDescription: EscapeDecoder consumes raw TTY bytes and emits typed Events. Supports legacy keys, Kitty keyboard protocol, SGR 1006 mouse, focus events, and bracketed paste. Original for PHP TUIs.
detailMeta: original — no 1:1 Go counterpart input foundation-package
